front-headline.purpose: The front page's one sentence stating the week's call; an italic brick phrase marks the decisive date.

headline.purpose: Inner page heads; states the finding, max 26ch, balanced.

figure.purpose: Figure strip values (32px under 640px); drawer figures 34px; docket counts 44px. No count-up.

section-head.purpose: Numbered front-page sections beside a 52px faint numeral.

wordmark.purpose: "Freshroots Planning Brief" in the masthead; the second half muted italic 400.

subtitle.purpose: Sub-heads in pages and the drawer; the drawer's product name at 30px.

lede.purpose: Under every headline, ink-2, max 64ch; 19px on the front page.

margin-note.purpose: Chart captions, runway notes, empty states, the issue line (15px), the colophon line.

body.purpose: Sans running text, paragraphs capped at 72ch.

table.purpose: Data cells; numeric columns right-aligned with lining tabular figures.

label.purpose: Tabs, figure labels, field labels, legends, column heads (12px muted).

small-caps.purpose: Runway group heads, the docket head, the drawer metadata line.

shadows.name: drawer-edge
shadows.purpose: The product drawer only; the one surface that floats.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Focused inputs, selects and search, with a moss border.

rules.name: ink
rules.purpose: Opens a section, the masthead (doubled), the drawer head, the colophon.

rules.name: strong
rules.purpose: Closes page heads, the section bar, figure strips, table heads, the runway axis.

rules.name: hairline
rules.purpose: Separates rows, figures, list items, disclosures.

rules.name: expectation
rules.purpose: Edges of a target span; only expectations are dashed.

texture.name: grain
texture.value: SVG fractalNoise, baseFrequency 0.85, 2 octaves, 180px tile, alpha 0.035
texture.purpose: Laid over oat paper on the body and every sticky or floating surface.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Shared curve for the page settle, drawer, toast and disclosure.

motion.name: scroll
motion.purpose: No smooth-scroll library; page scroll locks while the drawer is open.

motion.name: drawer
motion.purpose: Product drawer slide from the right.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Colour and border transitions on buttons and inputs.

motion.name: data
motion.purpose: Charts and figures render in place; nothing counts up, draws on or loops.

narrative.overview:
Freshroots Planner is a weekly bulletin for a fresh-food business, not a dashboard. Each week is an issue: a masthead with the wordmark "Freshroots Planning Brief", an issue line and a double ink rule, then a sticky section bar that reads like a newspaper's section index. The planner (Raghav) and procurement read it; they do not monitor it.

The front page states the week's call as a sentence, backs it with a lede, a docket of what is on Raghav's desk and one moss action. Below it, evidence is set the way a paper sets it: a pull-quote for the exception a person must judge, numbered sections, charts labelled in place, an italic caption, a moss-washed margin note and a colophon.

The ground is warm oat paper with a faint SVG grain; type is ink, not black. Newsreader carries everything that is read; Instrument Sans carries everything that is operated. Structure is drawn with hairline rules, never boxes or shadows; the only surface that floats is the product drawer. Motion is a 0.24s page fade and a 0.26s drawer slide; nothing animates data or loops.
keyCharacteristics: Masthead with serif wordmark, italic issue line and a double ink rule; sticky 46px section bar with counts and a "Reading as" role picker.
Every headline states the finding in a sentence; a serif lede explains it.
Grained oat paper, ink type, hairline rules instead of cards; no shadows on the page.
One action colour (moss). Brick reports running short, ochre reports too much, always with words.
Newsreader for reading, Instrument Sans for operating; lining tabular numerals on every figure.
The runway: run-out dates on a calendar, not weeks of cover on a bar chart.
Motion is a fade and a slide; nothing loops.

rules.name: The One Action Colour Rule
rules.body: Moss is the only colour that fills or underlines something you can act on. No other hue appears on a button, link or focus state; brick appears on a control only for the reject action, and only as text and border on transparent.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Brick and ochre never carry meaning by themselves. Every coloured line, dot or date sits beside words that say the same thing, and every runway row has an accessible label that states the run-out date and action.

rules.name: The Paper Ground Rule
rules.body: Every surface is the same oat paper with grain; sticky bars and the drawer repeat the grain rather than switching to a flat or frosted fill. Only inputs sit on the lighter Sheet.

rules.name: The Headline States the Finding Rule
rules.body: A headline is a sentence with a verb and a number or date taken from the data, never a page name. The lede says why, and what happens next.

rules.name: The Read in Serif, Operate in Sans Rule
rules.body: Anything read as prose or as a figure is Newsreader; anything clicked, scanned in a column or filled in is Instrument Sans.

rules.name: The Lining Figures Rule
rules.body: Every figure that can sit above or beside another sets lining tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Rules Not Boxes Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with lines on paper: an ink rule over each section, hairlines between rows and figures, a strong rule to close a head or strip. No card backgrounds, bordered blocks, rounded panels or page shadows.

rules.name: The One Floating Sheet Rule
rules.body: The drawer is the only surface that lifts off the page. Everything else, including sticky bars and the toast, is flat.

rules.name: The Dates Over Weeks Rule
rules.body: The runway shows when each product runs out as a calendar date, not weeks of cover. Weeks of cover appear only as a figure in the drawer, beside its target.

rules.name: The Nothing Loops Rule
rules.body: No motion repeats, follows the pointer or animates data. The page fades once and the drawer slides.

dos: **Do** write every headline as the finding, with a number or date from the data, followed by a serif lede.
**Do** keep moss for actions only: primary buttons, links, focus, the active tab.
**Do** pair every brick or ochre mark with words that say the same thing.
**Do** draw structure with rules on paper: ink to open, hairline to separate, strong rule to close.
**Do** set reading in Newsreader and operating in Instrument Sans, with lining tabular figures on every number.
**Do** label charts in place and shade festival weeks with a named band.
**Do** make every product row open the drawer with its evidence.
**Do** honour reduced motion and keep content visible without script.
donts: **Don't** bring back the dashboard: no sidebar, white cards, card shadows, rounded panels or KPI tiles.
**Don't** use cool greys, pure black or pure white; the palette is oat and ink.
**Don't** fill a button or link with brick or ochre, or use moss to tell data categories apart.
**Don't** let colour be the only signal of short or over stock.
**Don't** express the runway as weeks of cover or as a bar chart.
**Don't** add count-ups, draw-ons, scroll-triggered reveals, smooth scrolling or anything that loops.
**Don't** title a page with its name when the data supports a sentence.
